model.name: Two suites, both green: vitest (unit) and Playwright (e2e)
model.description: Tests are spread over test/vitest (56), test/e2e (21), test/visual (439 scripts), test/manual, test/playwright and test/baseline. ~22 vitest and 12 e2e tests fail on the prod line and nobody notices because nothing runs them automatically. Target: npm test + npm run test:e2e cover every check that matters, CI runs both, both are green, and a test run leaves git status clean.
model.poDirective: Tron 2026-11-22: radical consolidation of test users and CI, run by a separate Claude Code agent (not the oopTeam fleet).

acceptanceCriteria.text: CI runs build, vitest and e2e on every PR (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

gateRef.assertion: open a PR → three checks appear

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both suites are green on main; known failures are fixed or deleted, never skipped.
test/visual is triaged: behaviour checks become Playwright specs, source-text checks become vitest tests or are deleted, one-off probes are deleted.

gateRef.assertion: test/visual, test/manual, test/playwright, test/baseline no longer exist

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test run never changes tracked files (scenario/ and README writes go to the test data dir).

gateRef.assertion: run both suites → git status clean
